title: UiElementInfo
description: A UI tree node as consumed and produced by AutomationSandbox.Cli (automation-sandbox-heal) and AutomationSandbox.UiModel's UiTreeSerializer. A single node (no Children) describes the stale --expected locator; a node with Children describes the live --tree snapshot. The shape is identical whether the tree was captured via FlaUI (desktop) or Playwright (web) - the resolver draws no platform distinction. Required properties are the ones that materially drive SimilarityScorer's five weighted signals (ControlType, ParentControlType, SiblingPosition, Name, Position); everything else is optional metadata that improves scoring but has a safe default when omitted.

ControlType.description: UI Automation control type used for structural matching, e.g. "Button", "Edit", "Pane". Required: this is one of the five scored signals (weight 0.20).

Name.description: Human-readable accessible name of the element. Empty string means no name was captured - this is a valid, meaningful value (scored, weight 0.20), not an error.

AutomationId.description: Captured automation identifier. May be empty or duplicated across sibling elements - never treated as a unique node identity by the resolver, only as diagnostic/display data.

ClassName.description: Captured native or DOM class name. Diagnostic only - not one of SimilarityScorer's five weighted signals.

ParentControlType.description: Parent control type, denormalized onto this node so the resolver can score without walking back up the tree. One of the five scored signals (weight 0.20).

ParentAutomationId.description: Parent's captured identifier, for diagnostics only - need not be unique.

SiblingIndex.description: Zero-based position among the captured parent's children. Used with SiblingCount for the SiblingPosition signal (weight 0.15).

SiblingCount.description: Number of siblings including this node. Zero means missing sibling metadata (the signal is then excluded from scoring, not penalized).

TestIntent.description: Narrative business intent retained for prompts, generated tests, and reports. Not used by SimilarityScorer.

Children.description: Direct children in capture order. Omit or leave empty for a single-element --expected snapshot; populate for a --tree snapshot of the live application.

ChildControlTypeSignature.description: Direct-child ControlType multiset recorded at snapshot time, e.g. "Button:2|Edit:1". Only meaningful when the stale --expected locator was itself a container (drives the #375 descendant gate). Null or omitted when not applicable - never required.

boundingRectangle.description: Captured position and dimensions in the capture adapter's coordinate system. An all-zero rectangle represents missing geometry, not a real element at the origin.

X.description: Horizontal origin. One of the five scored signals, via the Position component (weight 0.25).

IsUsable.description: Computed (not required as input): true when Width or Height is non-zero. UiTreeSerializer.ToJson emits this, but UiTreeSerializer.FromJson ignores it on input - it has no [JsonConstructor] parameter. Present here only so the CLI's own output also validates against this schema.

IsEmpty.description: Computed (not required as input): true when X, Y, Width, and Height are all zero. Same ignored-on-input status as IsUsable.
